name: graphite-terminal
title: Graphite Terminal
description: Dark dense ops tooling. Near-black graphite steps, electric lime action, JetBrains Mono data over Inter body, tight radius, flat fast surfaces.
author: uiforagents
notes: Density is tight (ops tooling): 15px base, 36-40px rows, 4px grid. JetBrains Mono carries headings, numbers, ids, and latency columns; Inter carries prose. Lime is for action only. Surfaces are stepped graphite (bg 14.5% < card 17.5% < muted 21.5%); feedback is border/glow, never lift. Theme is scoped to [data-theme]/[data-identity] (no :root claim) so multiple identities can be imported side by side. One-shot test 2026-10-05: PASS - fresh agent given only prompt-pack + theme + overrides built a log-audit view (event log table, severity chips, filters, stat strip), identity-faithful, zero console errors, desktop 1280 + mobile 390 verified.
